rawArchive.contents: Command reports/logs, real runtime event logs, driver snapshots, traces, and counterexamples. User profiles, auth stores, node_modules and transform caches are excluded.

dependencies.outerWorkspace: Independent pnpm frozen-lock reification using the existing D: package store and hardlinks; official Electron binary installer completed.
dependencies.runtimePackages: Reused installed dependency directories only after comparing package manifests; runtime and desktop outputs were freshly built in the verification checkout.
dependencies.sharedWorkspaceResidual: Reinstallation in the original shared node_modules stopped at an Electron package rename because that binary was in use. No other application was stopped to replace it.

failedAttempts: Earlier startup timeouts, dependency/install failures, the invalid review-output path, and exploratory samples are retained in the raw archive. They are not acceptance passes.
restore: Extract the repo-local private ZIP and verify its manifest.json before replay; retained source candidate is named above.
